data_facts_with_para.paragraph: The Shenzhen-based firm says revenue rose by 29% to come in at 777 billion yuan ($107bn; £83bn), boosted by sales of its hybrid vehicles. This topped the $97.7bn reported by Elon Musk's Tesla.
BYD sold around the same number of EVs as Tesla last year – 1.76 million compared to 1.79 million, respectively.
But when sales of the Chinese company's hybrid cars are taken into account it is much bigger, selling a record 4.3 million vehicles globally in 2024.

facts.fact_content: BYD sold 4.3 million vehicles globally in 2024.
